reason: The text fragment (Exodus 1:15-22) describes the Egyptian midwives' fear of God and their refusal to obey Pharaoh's command to kill Hebrew male infants, resulting in God's blessing upon them and the multiplication of the Hebrew people. The passage does not address what is important to Yahweh regarding land. No mention of land (ארץ/eretz) appears in this text. While land is a significant theological theme elsewhere in the Hebrew Bible, this particular passage focuses on God rewarding those who fear Him and His protection of His people through the midwives' resistance.
